sections.title: Exact syntax tree and semantic binding

paragraphs: The correction [D,x1] disappears in the pro-two specialization. The semantic arbitrary-displayed-unit specialization and the actual tame map come from the procyclic core. Npc is NOT omega2-only: the genuine eta exponent must not be replaced by the omega resolver, and expressions using A mean its actual resolved action, not an independently guessed scalar.

The field-selection adapter below is NOT standard-three: it inherits the documented standing arithmetic and reciprocity inputs, and the probe prints its full axiom list rather than gating it. Standard-three analytic word certificates do not make the field theorem axiom-free.

paragraphs: The completed proof follows the FULL-OFFSET route, not the old two-coordinate Gate-E slice. Unramified uses the genuine cocycle coordinate x2 = Phi(c0) with (1-B^-1)Phi(c0) = (A^-1-1)c0; ramified uses x2 = B(A^-1-1)c0, whose actual cross term is B_V(c1, A^-1 c0) because B(A^-1-1)+Lc = A^-1 in characteristic two, so the coordinate change is invertible with NO inverse-Lc hypothesis. Displaying the old Gate-E polynomial with an invertible Lc as the completed normal-coordinate proof would be a content error, not merely a missing transcription. The old slice calculation remains valid in its own stated scope.

paragraphs: The word hash identifies the unexpanded canonical AST; the Fox hash identifies the serialized operation lists and normal matrices at the stated discrete parameters; the packet hash additionally binds the generated section content, the cited declaration names and the direct source bytes. None of them hashes a coefficient module, a marking, a field, a resolver, an eta value, or a completed certificate.

Strong checking re-emits both Lean exports, checks that every cited declaration exists with at most the standard three axioms, and compares the stored declaration transcript against a fresh replay. It does not assert independently authored expected signatures, and a matching declaration NAME is not a word-identity proof. The probe imports existing olean artifacts, so direct source hashes alone do not prove that those bytes produced those artifacts or came from an atomic filesystem snapshot; a separate isolated build is required. This STAGED packet does not enter the frozen five-fixture manifest, complete or supersede the five old appendix skeletons, activate a merge gate, or approve any release.
